game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mt. Pyre – Molten Bridge, a bridge over magma: the ember mage must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Comparison Duel: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the ember mage's power beats the shield shown by magma slimes.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Molten Bridge: a bridge over magma
core_gameplay_loop: In Molten Bridge, repeat each round: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the ember mage's power beats the shield shown by magma slimes. Each round, magma slimes strike the cooling vent, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the power value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the cooling vent from magma slimes in Molten Bridge: keep the power meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 59-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: power drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 59-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 5 (applied tier): Comparison Duel
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against magma slimes in Molten Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 59 seconds while power > 0.
